title: Spicy Egyptian Cheese Curry
description: A quick and flavorful curry with the warmth of Egyptian spices and the creaminess of cheese.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince garlic before adding to the curry

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add curry mix and Egyptian spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add cheese, chicken broth, and Greek yogurt. Stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
